d:
长发及腰勾勒着线条
水珠顺着颌角下滑
有致的身段倾身看你
指导的每一招一式
并没有记住
记住的
只有一开一合的唇瓣罢了
彼之良·白芨【泳社学姐/仿生2.2系列/155Rcm/仿生口腔结构/仿生肌理功能】

Long hair cascading to the waist traces her silhouette,
beads of water tracing the contour of her jawline.
When her sculpted frame bends closer to observe,
though she demonstrates each stroke with grace,
none of it truly stuck.
What lingered in memory,
was only the hypnotic rhythm of parted lips.
Bezlya Bletilla SwimClubSenior, Bionic 2.2 series 155cm R ver
